messages:
nina_support: Escalating Helix Analytics - embeddings ingestion started failing after tenant migration this morning. Customer reports broken search in prod and mentioned their renewal is due in 3 days. Blocking onboarding for one of their customers.
diego_cs: ugh. how severe? are they seeing errors in the UI or just ingestion backlog?
harper_eng: looks like 401s from our auth layer when posting to /v1/embeddings. sample from logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"unauthorized_client","detail":"tenant mapping missing"}
```
nina_support: verified with Helix (contact: sara@helix.ai). They migrated tenants at 07:12 UTC; our tenant map didn't pick up the new external_id helix-ext-12. They need this live for scheduled demo today.
diego_cs: priority = P0 for CS because this affects go-live + renewal convo. Need an external note and a short comms plan within 30m. Also: pause automated renewal reminders until we clear this.
leah_sales: I can pause renewal emails — filing request with growth-systems. tagging legal only if we propose a credit.
harper_eng: short term plan: manual mapping entry + cache purge on edge. I can run a scoped infrastructure change:
```
redwoodctl tenant map add --tenant=helix-tenant-12 --external-id=helix-ext-12
redwoodctl cache purge --scope=tenant:helix-tenant-12
```
ETA 25m including verification. I'll need ops go-ahead.
nina_support: ops-bot: request manual tenant-mapping for helix-tenant-12 with external_id=helix-ext-12
infra-bot: @harper_eng request received. Ticket INF-4942 created and assigned. Change window: now.
diego_cs: comms plan (draft): 1) immediate SMS+email to Sara and their ops lead: short apology + ETA. 2) hourly updates until resolved. 3) if unresolved in >2h offer 1 month pro-rated credit and a technical postmortem. Approve?
leah_sales: approve the pro-rated credit. I'll handle billing adjustment and notify finance for accounting notes.
harper_eng: performing change now. will post command output when done.
harper_eng: mapping applied, cache purge triggered. logs now show 200 on embedding writes in staging.
```
200 OK {"status":"accepted","items":20}
```
nina_support: running quick smoke in prod - hitting embedding endpoint and verifying index refresh. All good so far. Sara confirmed her demo page shows results.
diego_cs: posting external message (keeps it short): "We're aware of an ingestion issue for Helix after a tenant migration. Engineers applied a fix; ingestion is back. We're monitoring and will follow up with details and a credit if needed." Sending now.
leah_sales: I've paused renewal reminders and started billing note draft. looping finance + legal to finalize credit mechanics.
diego_cs: owners: ENG=@harper_eng, SUPPORT=@nina_support, CS=@diego_cs, SALES=@leah_sales. I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem and include migration checklist updates.
infra-bot: INF-4942 updated: change executed, verification complete, awaiting billing note for closure. Closing ETA: 48h.
nina_support: closing out here. will reopen if Helix sees regression. :white_check_mark:
